summary: PR #1969 checkpoint C, note docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, continuation from b0c8d2b37105566fad7206cd5c63806a1b278626. A strictly productive receipt constitutively requires an exercised giver; existence of a bearer by that receipt in alternative realizations and potential closure of all such suppliers in C are separate open bridges. For arbitrary admissible input/output relation D on subsets of the actual roster, the component guard G (C-free input implies C-free allowed output) and a joint retained realization J (at U=A minus C there is an output containing U) imply D(U,U), since that output must equal U. Under G, J is equivalent to D(U,U); warrant needs a genuinely retained joint productive witness, not a restatement. For C=A, J is existence of an output at empty input. A varying-supplier nonmonotone finite control meets the weaker guard while violating the fixed actual supplier menu and monotonicity. Earlier monotone proof can find a proper survivor when J for U fails; sufficient packages are not generally ordered. Individually available outputs do not imply jointly available outputs: exhaustive Python diagnostic over all nonempty families of subsets of one to three retained members; at size three 90 of 218 covering families omit full U, while all 128 directed covering families contain U. Infinite finite-subsets family separates finite joint coverage from full realization. A reused strict successor-chain equation with necessary identity-fixed suppliers under a stipulated two-world frame shows the purely modal and relational conditions do not entail a root; no claim of metaphysical possibility. Guarded receipt and source-triggered laws alone lack positive existential import on an otherwise admissible empty component. Non-deletion is not justified for all contingent effects; nonnecessitating actual explanation should instead explain availability of productive input. Source-relative explanatory advantage at the received-effect scope is conditional on genuine nonreceived availability and productive exercise; a brute necessary source incurs the same burden for its own actuality.
